# authwise_guard_nodes (Data Source)

A server's node in a Guard network, registered ahead of time. Created without a `public_key`, it is `PENDING` and its one-time `auth_code` enrols the server; created with one, it is `ACTIVE` at once. The auth code is shown once, so it is kept in state: treat the state as sensitive. People's nodes join by invite and are not managed here. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The Guard tenant's id, `authwise_guard_tenant.<name>.guard_tenant_id` (`gt-…`); the provider's `tenant_id` is not used.

### Optional

- `network_id` (String) Parent identifier `network_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `guard_nodes` (Attributes List) Every node under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guard_nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--guard_nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guard_nodes`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `allowed_ips` (List of String)
- `auth_code` (String, Sensitive)
- `auth_code_expires_at` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `endpoint` (String)
- `guard_node_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `last_seen_at` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `owner_id` (String)
- `public_key` (String)
- `roles` (List of String)
- `state` (String)
